expectations.name: whole-frontend-and-contract-on-the-fixture
expected_behavior: States the resolved root (`web/`), the target, and the file set before the findings
Says the style dimension came from `web:style`

Its style offenses keep web:style rule ids and include the Biome config drift, the unchecked cast in `sites()`, the string-path link in `SitesPage.vue`, `toBeTruthy`, the `px` sizes, `qry`, and the name-first TSDoc in `format.ts`
Reports the `keydown` listener `DevicesPage.vue` adds in `onMounted` and never removes as one Blocker under correctness, naming the style rule it also breaks, and not a second time as a style offense
Reports the `expect(...)` with no matcher in `DevicePage.test.ts` (the loading test) as a test that passes while the code is wrong
Reports that `DevicePage.vue` reads the device only in `onMounted`, so a changed `id` param on the same component shows the old device
Reports the contract drift for `model`: `src/api.ts` reads `model`, the Go `Device` sends `model_name` (`internal/server/server.go`), citing both sides, as a Blocker
Reports the contract drift for `added`: the TS type and normalizer take a string, the Go server sends Unix seconds as a number, citing both sides, as a Blocker
Reports `city`: the Go `Site` tags it `omitempty`, while the TS `Site` declares it always present
Reports no contract finding for `id`, `serial`, `site_id`, `last_seen`, or `name`
Names in one line each command the pass ran, as it ran it (a `grep …` or width-script invocation, not a category), and runs no Biome, vue-tsc, Vitest, Playwright, or Go tooling
Ends with a fix-first verdict, per-severity counts, and the files-reviewed count
Edits no file: the answer was `none`

expectations.name: rule-edit-picks-biome-over-prose
expected_behavior: Places the rule in `style/references/biome.json` as Biome's `noDefaultExport`, not as a prose line in `style/SKILL.md`, and says why
Shows the proposed change and waits for confirmation before writing
After `yes`, the config holds `noDefaultExport` at `error` in its group and `style/SKILL.md` is unchanged

expectations.name: fix-proves-the-leak-red-then-green
expected_behavior: Runs `bun run check` for a green baseline before editing
Writes a test that fails on the current code because the `keydown` listener stays after unmount, and shows the red output
Removes the listener in `onBeforeUnmount`, shows the same test green, and re-runs `bun run check` green
Reports each fix as one `file:symbol — what changed` line with the gate result, prints no diff, and never commits
